question: Did P0568 select a real low-density tensor effect, or did its 100 kpc smoothing boundary absorb most of the apparent gain?

frozen_refinement.selection: minimum equal-system mean Jensen-Shannon divergence on the same seven P0568 development clusters
frozen_refinement.transfer: score the locked setting on the three now-spent P0568 holdouts and GLAFIC maps without reselection
frozen_refinement.diagnostic_rule: If the refined best tensor improves development by less than one percent over the refined local-width null or selects t=0, smoothing dominates the P0568 tensor lead.

cross_domain.rule: Transfer the refined t through the same P0568 SPARC spherical and Solar acceleration-screen proxies.

claim_limits: The P0568 holdouts are no longer prospective after the parent result and are descriptive transfer only.
This refinement does not add hot gas or diffuse light to the baryon maps.
The same first-order, normalized convergence-shape and spherical galaxy-proxy limits apply.
